items.title: Recent PHP Vulnerabilities

items.title: Discovering and exploiting vulnerabilities in critical, real-world software with Claude
items.summary: Over the past few months, we’ve used an unreleased, internal research model to find critical vulnerabilities in some of the world’s most widely used software, such as browsers and operating systems.

items.title: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government
items.summary: We are expanding our partnership with the General Services Administration (GSA) through a new agreement that gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API.
